python3 -c "
import calendar
from datetime import date

# January 1939
year = 1939
month = 1

# Get the calendar for January 1939
cal = calendar.monthcalendar(year, month)

# Find all Thursdays and Wednesdays
thursdays = []
wednesdays = []

for week in cal:
    # Monday is index 0, Thursday is index 3, Wednesday is index 2
    if week[3] != 0:  # Thursday exists in this week
        thursdays.append(week[3])
    if week[2] != 0:  # Wednesday exists in this week
        wednesdays.append(week[2])

print('January 1939 Thursdays:', thursdays)
print('January 1939 Wednesdays:', wednesdays)
print()
print('Third Thursday:', thursdays[2] if len(thursdays) >= 3 else 'N/A')
print('Fourth Wednesday:', wednesdays[3] if len(wednesdays) >= 4 else 'N/A')
"
